categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Green Precision Components Co., Ltd primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of precision structural components and precision molds. Its products are widely used in smart home devices, smartphones, wearable devices, tablets, and electronic cigarettes. The company also produces precision molds essential for manufacturing these structural components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes injection molding, metal forming, surface treatment, stamping, CNC machining, die casting, and automated manufacturing technologies. It emphasizes high-precision mold design and manufacturing, multi-material integration (plastic, metal, glass), and functional integration such as antennas, electromagnetic shielding, acoustic chambers, heat dissipation, waterproofing, dustproofing, and decorative features. The company also develops automated assembly lines and precision inspection devices to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers are leading domestic and international brands in the smart terminal industry, including manufacturers of smart home devices, smartphones, wearable devices, tablets, and electronic cigarettes. Its products serve major end markets in consumer electronics and smart devices sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Guangdong Province. It has established subsidiaries and production bases in Vietnam and Hong Kong, serving both domestic and international markets. Overseas sales accounted for approximately 57.68% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Green Precision Components operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing precision structural components and molds that are critical inputs for smart terminal device assembly by downstream electronics manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in 'functionalization of structural components,' investing in new materials, technologies, and processes to develop high value-added products. It aims to enhance modular intelligent manufacturing and automation, deepen collaboration with universities and research institutes, and expand R&D into emerging fields such as AI smart terminals, satellite communications, new energy, drones, and medical aesthetics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision structural components and precision molds to customers. The company operates a direct sales model, with revenue recognized at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance. It also earns investment income from financial products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading high-tech enterprise with strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive one-stop manufacturing solutions, and a stable customer base among top-tier domestic and international smart terminal brands. It emphasizes multi-material integration and rapid product iteration capabilities as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, an 8.63% increase over 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 53 million, a 308.51% increase year-over-year. The company maintains a stable asset base of over RMB 2.2 billion and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures around RMB 88 million in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly customized, multifunctional precision structural components integrating diverse materials and functions such as antennas, electromagnetic shielding, acoustic chambers, and environmental protections. It provides customers with high-quality, cost-effective, and rapidly deliverable products supported by advanced manufacturing technologies and comprehensive technical solutions, enabling clients to meet fast product update cycles and complex design requirements.
